mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate environment consistently reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.0% signals weakening labor market conditions, which typically precedes corporate earnings deterioration and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential investment (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in demand, which triggers a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 105.0), manufacturing sector weakness leads to reduced corporate profitability and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: A strong housing market (HOUST above 1300.0) consistently signals robust consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1300.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 255.0 indicates accelerating inflation, which typically prompts central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 255.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) signals a deteriorating labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in PAYEMS and rise in UNRATE fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong economic growth (GDPC1 > 17500.0), consumer and business spending surges, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 exceeds 17500.0.
